specification:
GEOMETRY ROOT — [ACTOR_1] is positioned immediately behind [ACTOR_2] in a close rear-aligned standing hinge. [ACTOR_2] bends forward through the hip joints with mild anterior pelvic tilt, a gentle inward lumbar line, and softly flexed knees; avoid a rounded upper/lower-back silhouette. Both actors retain their assigned body and furniture support contacts.

BASE SUPPORT GEOMETRY — USER-SUPPLIED DESIGN CONSTRAINTS, not image-observed: [ACTOR_2] forward-hinges with both arms directed backward rather than reaching forward to a surface. The knees soften and the feet maintain a standing base; the rear partner may maintain an accompanying gentle elbow/waist support, but must not suspend the front participant by the arms. This higher-demand silhouette keeps mild pelvic tilt and lumbar lordosis, not a forced shoulder extension or exaggerated backbend. FRONT SUPPORT: Both feet on [FLOOR]; no front hand, elbow, chest, or wall support; front body weight must be independently borne by the legs, with rear contact only supplementary. REAR SUPPORT: Both feet of [ACTOR_1] supported by [FLOOR]; knees softly flexed.

STRUCTURAL VARIATION — Baseline support geometry remains unchanged.

V00 REAR ARM DEFAULT — The front partner directs both arms rearward past the outer hip line toward the rear partner's flanks/back, rather than leaving them loosely behind the front torso. The rear partner reaches forward with an upper-arm/shoulder receiving hold. Baseline rear-arm placement; no additional variation angle.

HANDS-BACK PATH — Both front arms continue rearward past the front lateral hip line toward the rear participant's flanks/back. The front remains independently foot-supported.

INHERITANCE AND SUPPORT — Preserve the exact named leg/surface support topology and independent balance anchors from the base. Parent: USDG-PULL-V00. No paired inheritance change.

SOURCE BOUNDARY — User-designed text geometry, no source photograph or demonstrated physical pose; geometry and model fidelity remain untested.
